en.title: **Technical Lead** & **Product Engineer**
en.text:
Led product engineering and architecture across the entire technology department — designing, building, and shipping operational SaaS platforms used to run the company's biomedical operations.

  • Defined system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across the company's software stack.
  • Architected and shipped BioSwift, a multi-module SaaS platform covering clients, equipment, inventory, and service-order operations.
  • Owned AWS infrastructure end-to-end — EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53 — including deployment, scaling, and security.
  • Built full product features across Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB, and SQL, focused on scalability and product delivery.
  • Designed automation systems to streamline data, reporting, and operational workflows across departments.
  • Led a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and analysts under modern delivery practices.
  • Translated business needs into technical roadmaps, system designs, and shipped features.

es.title: **Technical Lead** & **Product Engineer**
es.text:
Lideré la ingeniería de producto y la arquitectura de todo el departamento de tecnología — diseñando, construyendo y lanzando plataformas SaaS operativas utilizadas para correr las operaciones biomédicas de la compañía.

  • Definí la arquitectura de sistemas, la estrategia técnica y los estándares de ingeniería del stack de software de la compañía.
  • Arquitecté y lancé BioSwift, una plataforma SaaS multi-módulo para clientes, equipos, inventario y órdenes de servicio.
  • Operé la infraestructura AWS end-to-end — EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53 — incluyendo despliegue, escalado y seguridad.
  • Construí features completos en Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB y SQL, enfocados en escalabilidad y entrega de producto.
  • Diseñé sistemas de automatización para optimizar datos, reportes y flujos operativos entre departamentos.
  • Lideré un equipo cross-functional de ingenieros, diseñadores y analistas bajo prácticas modernas de delivery.
  • Traduje necesidades de negocio en roadmaps técnicos, diseños de sistema y features lanzados a producción.

fr.title: **Technical Lead** & **Product Engineer**
fr.text:
J'ai dirigé l'ingénierie produit et l'architecture du département technologie — en concevant, construisant et livrant des plateformes SaaS opérationnelles utilisées pour faire tourner les opérations biomédicales de l'entreprise.

  • Définition de l'architecture système, de la stratégie technique et des standards d'ingénierie de la stack logicielle.
  • Architecte et livreur de BioSwift, une plateforme SaaS multi-module pour clients, équipements, inventaire et ordres de service.
  • Ownership complet de l'infrastructure AWS — EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53 — déploiement, scalabilité et sécurité.
  • Développement de fonctionnalités complètes en Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB et SQL, axées sur la scalabilité et la livraison produit.
  • Conception de systèmes d'automatisation pour rationaliser data, reporting et workflows opérationnels.
  • Direction d'une équipe cross-fonctionnelle d'ingénieurs, designers et analystes selon des pratiques modernes de delivery.
  • Traduction des besoins métier en roadmaps techniques, designs système et features livrées en production.

ko.title: **Technical Lead** & **Product Engineer**
ko.text:
전체 기술 부서의 제품 엔지니어링과 아키텍처를 리드하며, 회사의 의료기기 운영을 구동하는 운영 SaaS 플랫폼을 설계, 구축, 출시했습니다.

  • 회사 소프트웨어 스택 전반의 시스템 아키텍처, 기술 전략, 엔지니어링 표준 정의.
  • 고객, 장비, 재고, 서비스 주문을 아우르는 멀티 모듈 SaaS 플랫폼 BioSwift를 아키텍팅하고 출시.
  • 배포·확장·보안을 포함한 AWS 인프라(EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, Route 53) 엔드투엔드 오너십.
  • Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB, SQL 기반의 풀스택 기능을 확장성과 제품 딜리버리에 초점을 맞춰 구축.
  • 부서 전반의 데이터, 리포팅, 운영 워크플로우를 간소화하는 자동화 시스템 설계.
  • 현대적 딜리버리 프랙티스로 엔지니어, 디자이너, 애널리스트 크로스 펑셔널 팀을 리드.
  • 비즈니스 니즈를 기술 로드맵, 시스템 디자인, 그리고 실제 출시 기능으로 전환.

en.title: **Customer Care Advisor**
en.text: Customer support role — built foundational discipline in communication, prioritization, and operations later transferred to engineering and product work.

es.title: **Asesor de Atención al Cliente**
es.text: Rol de soporte al cliente — base sólida en comunicación, priorización y operaciones, posteriormente trasladada al trabajo de ingeniería y producto.

fr.title: **Conseiller en Service Client**
fr.text: Rôle de support client — base solide en communication, priorisation et opérations, transférée ensuite au travail d'ingénierie et de produit.

ko.title: **고객 케어 어드바이저**
ko.text: 고객 지원 역할 — 커뮤니케이션, 우선순위 설정, 운영 디시플린의 기초를 다졌고 이후 엔지니어링과 제품 업무로 전환했습니다.
